captions.detailed: A tower-mounted three-branch rotary stand featuring a wide, flat cylindrical black base and a central grey vertical tower. Mounted along the tower are three separate cylindrical collars colored red, green, and blue from bottom to top, separated by grey flange rings. From each collar, a single L-shaped radial arm of matching color extends outward and upward, terminating in a small black spherical knob. Each of the three arms is independently rotatable around the vertical axis of the tower.
captions.instruction: Generate a tower-mounted three-branch rotary stand with a heavy black base, a central vertical grey tower, and three independently rotating, color-coded radial arms (red, green, and blue) with black spherical tips.
captions.factory: Construct a base using a wide, flat cylinder and a vertical tower using a taller, narrower cylinder. Model the three rotating collars by placing cylinders of red, green, and blue colors along the vertical tower, separated by wider grey flange rings. For each arm, construct an L-shaped member using swept circles or combined cylinders, color-matching its respective collar, and top it with a black sphere. Define three revolute joints, each connecting one collar-arm assembly to the vertical tower at its respective height, rotating around the Z-axis.
